stem.en: Sort each action of a party into the job it does.

text.en: Party workers collect residents' signatures about a broken water pipe
A ward meeting turns what residents want into one demand
A party speaks at every meeting about one hospital for the district
A party holds a rally for a new bridge
Candidates of two rival parties offer different plans for one bus route
Party A and Party B put forward different plans for the same seat
A party prints its promises so voters can read them before polling
Two parties debate on radio, so listeners hear both sides

explanation.en: Gathering what people want organises public opinion. Speaking up for one named issue is campaigning. Rival plans give voters a meaningful choice. Printed promises and open debates help voters decide with the facts in front of them.

hints.en: Ask what the party is doing: gathering, speaking up, offering a difference, or giving facts?
